title: Clean invoice, full 3-way match
story: Apex Office Supplies bills exactly what was ordered and received on PO-2026-0412. Intra-state CGST+SGST.

title: Split billing ahead of goods receipt
story: Coldline sends the 2nd invoice on a 10-chiller PO. 4 were already billed, only 6 have been received - but this invoice bills 6 more (+6 installations).

title: Duplicate in disguise
story: Sterling re-sends an already-approved invoice as a 'payment reminder' - different template, number re-formatted from SPI/26-27/0457 to SPI-26-27-457.

title: Bank account changed on invoice
story: A perfect-looking Kaveri IT invoice - PO, receipt, GST all match - but it asks to pay a new Kotak account. Classic payment-diversion fraud pattern.

title: Scanned, no PO, tax-inclusive prices
story: A skewed, noisy scan with no text layer. No PO number, GST-inclusive pricing, unit price slightly above PO. Needs OCR, PO inference and GST netting.

title: Vendor blocked by Procurement
story: Orbit Electricals was blocked after a failed compliance audit but still sends an invoice against an old PO.

title: Incomplete tax invoice
story: Apex forgot the invoice number and date - the invoice can't legally support a GST input-credit claim.
